name: Lacustrine-Mastaba
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws impact-scarred wastelands, patient as erosion itself.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on titanium and rare flora are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
